verdict.rationale: LiteLLM is documented as a self-hosted gateway that routes your traffic to many providers and load-balances across deployments such as Azure and OpenAI, which implies the operator supplies their own provider credentials. However, no cited item explicitly describes configuring provider API keys or per-request/per-user bring-your-own-key pass-through. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of provider API key configuration, per-key or per-user BYOK credential pass-through, and independent hands-on confirmation of BYOK traffic routing.
